faq.name: faq
faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Common questions about template video credits.

items.title: How are credits used?
items.description: One 720p template video costs 30 credits. The generate button shows that cost before you submit. The $9.90 pack is 30 credits, exactly one video.

items.title: Do failed generations refund credits?
items.description: Yes. When a task fails, reserved credits are released back to your balance automatically.

items.title: Can I upgrade or cancel?
items.description: These are one-time credits and do not renew. Buy another pack when you need more videos.

items.title: Can I get a refund?
items.description: We currently do not offer refunds. Review the pack before purchasing. For exceptional cases, contact support@shipfire.app.

items.title: What is one video?
items.description: Upload two photos and generate one 720p clip from the current template. The template supplies the scene, motion and sound.

items.title: Can I get help using the product?
items.description: Contact support@shipfire.app. The 3-video pack includes priority support.
